visualDiagnosticFindings.finding: Original graticule strokes appear among international/administrative candidates. Example current chain 0 follows a northern segment of the printed 30°E meridian; the horizontal 60°N line and other meridians are also highlighted. No candidate was excluded or edited.
The patterned Greenland ice/background at the upper left produces a dense network of provisional border strokes and small faces. These are not national boundaries.

The Europe title box, header/footer decoration and letter fragments appear among candidates. The map has a scale bar, north arrow and printed projection; no discrete class-key legend validating model output is visible.
Candidate strokes visually follow parts of coasts and islands, but the coast channel is unobserved and masked. No coastline extraction is claimed; all present chain semanticBits are 1 or 3.

The map primarily labels countries and major physical features, not a documented city/capital symbol layer. 28 detections have algorithmic symbol candidates; none was manually accepted. Source crops of Volga and Romania show a river stroke or tiny text/line fragments rather than a verified city symbol. Poland and France have symbol:null; their OCR label centres were not turned into accepted controls.

The gazetteer returns settlement homonyms for country/river labels (for example Poland in the US and Volga settlements). matching.matches contain OCR-centre search metadata; these are not fitted or accepted city coordinates. No warp or calibration exists.

The installed pipeline reported duplicate-control-observations, zero attempted projections and zero locationCandidates. warp/calibration/quality remain null; no fabricated controls, label-centre controls or modern boundary supplementation were applied.

Winkel II (world) is printed on the original. The installed structured projection contract lists geographic, eqc, merc, lcc, laea, aeqd, stere and robin; Winkel II is absent. The spelling was not silently substituted with Winkel Tripel/Robinson/geographic and no projection edit was applied.
Only one OCR grid label (60°N) survived; independentLongitudeLabels=0, independentLatitudeLabels=0 and grid.points=[]; the label is unresolved. No graticule control was invented.

The PDF contains a 4400×3400 embedded JPEG, while the installed default renderer defines original source pixels as its 144-dpi page raster, 1584×1224. Default maxPixels=4000000 remains unchanged and no crop is used. Actual analysis is 1938816 pixels (1.939 MP); the 4MP setting is a ceiling, not a request to upscale. Next-turn pixel edits must use this 1584×1224 job plane or full-original UV, not the embedded JPEG coordinates.
